items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: They made okay a deal with Duffy for him to get 25 percent, because Duffy was the kingpin in that part of New York.

ctx.x: And then they just started alternating, because both bands got big where they could go on the road. So when Duke would go out, we'd go in.
